deny.english-code: code must be in English only: identifiers, comments, and logs. Test files are excluded: test names and test data can use the language of the project. Put user-facing text in the translation file (lang/, locales/, i18n/) and use the key through the i18n of the stack. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/english-code.md. For user-facing text, load ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/i18n.md for the pattern of each stack.
deny.test-id: every interactive element of a component needs data-testid: button, a, input, select, textarea, form, and every element with a click, submit, change, or input handler. Use a business name in kebab-case (profile-save-button). In a repeated item, use the business id (item-card-${item.sku}), never the position. A wrapper that forwards the attributes of the parent (v-bind="$attrs" in Vue, {...rest} in React) passes. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/test-ids.md.
deny.test-skip: do not skip, focus, or disable a test (.skip, .only, .todo, xit, fit, markTestSkipped, t.Skip, #[ignore], @Disabled). A red test shows what the code lacks: fix the code. If the specification changed, change the test together with it. See craft:atdd.
deny.e2e-container: an E2E test runs only in a container, never on the host. Run it with the e2e service of the compose file: docker compose run --rm e2e <command>. If the project has no e2e service yet, create it with the official image of the runner at the version of the package (mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, cypress/included:<version>). See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/atdd/references/e2e-container.md.
deny.filtered-tests: run only the tests that the change can break, with a filter: the test file or folder, related, --filter, -k, -t, -run. The full suite runs in CI. Without CI, it runs locally only before a push or a PR/MR, with the consent of the user through AskUserQuestion (Run the full suite locally / Continue without the full suite). For the filter of each runner, see ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/atdd/references/filtered-tests.md.
deny.push-gate: the project has no CI, so no place runs the full suite after the push. Before a push or a PR/MR, ask the user with AskUserQuestion if you must run the full suite locally. Use the exact options Run the full suite locally and Continue without the full suite. If the user chooses to run it, run the suite and push only when it is green. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/atdd/references/filtered-tests.md.
deny.research-first: research before you create infra or pin a version. Find the official guide and the expert practice for the subject (the state-of-the-art rule), and check the version in the registry (the verify rule). Use WebSearch, WebFetch, Context7, or a registry command (npm view, docker manifest inspect). Cite the sources in the reply. Then edit again.
deny.memory-outside-project: memory belongs to the project, in .claude/memory/, inside the repo. Write the file there and add the line to .claude/memory/MEMORY.md. Local memory (~/.claude/projects/) is valid only on this machine and the team cannot see it. See craft:memory.
context.memory-empty: The project has no memory yet. Create .claude/memory/MEMORY.md with the first memory.

context.change:
# Write the change

- Before you edit, read the code the change touches and search every caller. Fix a bug once, in the shared code that the callers use.
- Keep the public signature of a function that has callers. A new dependency (a clock, a sleep, a fetch) enters as an optional last parameter with a default.
- Never edit an existing test to fit the change. A failing existing test shows a caller that the change broke.
- Check the inputs that break the rule: zero, empty, negative, the limit value, a duplicate, two calls at the same time. Reject with an error only an input that the rule cannot compute, never with a silent wrong result. Accept every common form of a valid value (upper case, spaces).
- Write the smallest complete change. Add no option, abstraction, or code for later that nobody asked for. Add the fewest tests that prove the change: one per rule or edge, never the same case twice.
- Test behavior: a rule, a branch, a parser, money, security, a contract. A visual-only change (style, color, spacing, layout, animation, decorative markup) gets no test: review the rendered screen (design:style). A text, a rename, or a config value gets no new test.
- Run the tests once per step: the red run of the new test, then the green run after the code. A fix of one or two lines skips the red run: write the test with the fix and run once. Do not run the suite before the change only to see it pass. Do not run it again to read another part of the output.
context.reminder: [craft] 2+ actions: one task each (TaskCreate). Before code or config: official docs, expert practice, native or vetted package first. Memory: only a correction or a decision the code does not show.
